selection_process: Selection follows a three-stage process: Preliminary Examination

Preliminary Examination (Objective type): A screening exam only - its marks are not added to the Main Examination or Interview marks. It has two objective-type papers. Paper-2 (General Mental Ability Test) is qualifying only

requiring a minimum of 33% marks for all categories. Ranking for qualifying to the Main Examination is based solely on Paper-1 (General Studies) marks. Calculators are not allowed. Negative marking applies: 1/4 of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for each wrong answer; multiple answers to one question are treated as wrong; unattempted questions attract no penalty. Main Examination (Written/Descriptive type): Held at examination centres in Haldwani and Haridwar
using a Question-Answer Booklet (QAB) format. Answers must be given entirely in English or entirely in Hindi (Devanagari script) for a given paper - mixing languages within one paper is not allowed
except for technical terms. Interview: Candidates declared successful in the Main Examination must submit an online post-wise preference (Online Preference Sheet) before the Interview stage.
The detailed subject-wise Main Examination papers
and full syllabus for Preliminary and Main Examinations are provided in a separate appendix of the official notification.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website psc.uk.gov.in or pscuk.net.in
Go to the "How to Apply" link in the menu bar, review the Advertisement Details, Important Dates, and Instructions for filling up the online application form
Click "Apply Now" and complete the Registration form with accurate details; create a password and submit
Verify the Basic Information displayed; tick the verification declaration and submit, or edit if any correction is needed
After successful Primary Registration, a message will be sent to your registered mobile number and email - click "Click here to login"
Fill in Educational Details (High School, Intermediate, Graduate, and other qualifications) and select the post(s) you are eligible for
Upload your photo and signature as per the specified format, and tick the declaration
Review all filled details carefully, then click the Final Submit button to complete the application
Pay the application fee online via Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI
Take a printout of the completed online application form for future reference

If an error is found before Final Submission, applicants can go back and edit the form. After Final Submission, no changes are possible except during the separate Edit/Correction window (07–16 October 2026); the mobile number cannot be edited even during this window.
important_instructions: Reservation and age relaxation benefits apply only to candidates who are domicile of Uttarakhand; non-domicile candidates in reserved categories can only apply under the Unreserved (General) category Category/sub-category, once claimed in the online application, cannot be changed after final submission under any circumstances Candidates submitting fake certificates (educational qualification/age/reservation) will be debarred from all future Commission examinations for up to 5 years, along with possible legal action No 25% additional waiting list will be prepared for these posts, as this is a joint/combined examination per the applicable Government Order Admit cards will not be sent by post - candidates must download them from the Commission's website using their registration number and date of birth Selection at every stage is provisional; if a candidate is found not to meet the prescribed eligibility at any stage - even after final selection - their candidature will be cancelled Candidates must mark their thumb impression (left thumb for male candidates, right thumb for female candidates) on the answer sheet at the designated place, or the answer sheet will not be evaluated Complaints regarding the conduct of the examination must be submitted through the prescribed process within the stipulated time Important information will be sent to candidates via email or SMS, so candidates must enter their own correct mobile number and email ID in the application

content_sections.heading: UKPSC Combined State Civil Services Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection follows a three-stage process: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and Interview. Preliminary Examination (Objective type): A screening exam only - its marks are not added to the Main Examination or Interview marks. It has two objective-type papers. Paper-2 (General Mental Ability Test) is qualifying only, requiring a minimum of 33% marks for all categories. Ranking for qualifying to the Main Examination is based solely on Paper-1 (General Studies) marks. Calculators are not allowed. Negative marking applies: 1/4 of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for each wrong answer; multiple answers to one question are treated as wrong; unattempted questions attract no penalty. Main Examination (Written/Descriptive type): Held at examination centres in Haldwani and Haridwar, using a Question-Answer Booklet (QAB) format. Answers must be given entirely in English or entirely in Hindi (Devanagari script) for a given paper - mixing languages within one paper is not allowed, except for technical terms. Interview: Candidates declared successful in the Main Examination must submit an online post-wise preference (Online Preference Sheet) before the Interview stage. The detailed subject-wise Main Examination papers, marks distribution, and full syllabus for Preliminary and Main Examinations are provided in a separate appendix of the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is UKPSC Combined State Civil Services Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. A-1/E-1/2026-27 issued by the Uttarakhand Public Service Commission for 67 Group-B posts across 16 positions under the Uttarakhand Combined State Civil/Upper Subordinate Services Examination 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 67 total vacancies across 16 posts, including Deputy Collector (10), Police Deputy Superintendent (14), Block Development Officer (5), Assistant Regional Transport Officer (5), and others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UKPSC Combined State Civil Services Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 29 September 2026 at 11:59:59 PM; the exam fee must also be paid by the same date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for UKPSC Combined State Civil Services posts?
faq.answer: Most posts require a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university; specific posts like Assistant Director/Audit Officer, Assistant Labour Commissioner, and Case Worker have subject-specific or postgraduate requirements - see the Eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UKPSC Combined State Civil Services Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 42 years as on 1 July 2026, with 5 years' relaxation for Uttarakhand SC/ST/OBC, PwD, freedom fighter dependents, and up to 5 years for ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UKPSC Combined State Civil Services Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹166.36 for Unreserved/OBC/EWS candidates and ₹76.36 for Uttarakhand SC/ST/PwD candidates (Preliminary Exam); Uttarakhand orphan children are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UKPSC Combined State Civil Services Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must register and apply through psc.uk.gov.in or pscuk.net.in, complete the online form with educational and personal details, upload photo/signature, and pay the fee online before 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for UKPSC Combined State Civil Services Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A three-stage process: a qualifying Preliminary Examination (objective type, two papers), a Main Examination (written/descriptive), and an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for UKPSC Combined State Civil Services posts?
faq.answer: Most posts carry a pay scale of ₹56,100–1,77,500 (Level-10); State Tax Officer carries ₹44,900–1,42,400 (Level-07); Case Worker carries ₹35,400–1,12,400 (Level-06).

faq.question: Q10. Is reservation available to candidates outside Uttarakhand?
faq.answer: No - reservation and age relaxation benefits under this recruitment are available only to candidates who are domicile of Uttarakhand.
